_comment: The whole Discord server as data. discord/setup_server.py reads this file and builds it. Safe to re-run: it only creates what is missing. Edit here, not in the Discord UI, so the server can be rebuilt.

roles.name: Guild Master
roles.about: One. Made the website. Gets the GM bonus. Asking about the GM bonus is -50 DKP.

roles.name: Rank 1 (Middle Mgmt)
roles.about: Officers. They have enough stress already.

roles.name: Rank 4 (does not exist)
roles.about: Do not assign this to anyone. Nobody knows what happened to Rank 4.

roles.name: Consultant
roles.about: Plays a different game, a different faction, or PvE. Still welcome. Billed hourly.

roles.name: First Aid Kits Only
roles.about: Heals, but with bandages. Counts as a healer on Mondays.

roles.name: Paladin (CLOSED)
roles.about: We have enough. The role still opens, out of respect.

roles.name: Gaming Monday
roles.about: Ping role for 19:30 Mondays. Opt in, opt out, nobody takes it personally.

roles.name: Alliance Spy
roles.about: Honesty is appreciated. Will be reported to Middle Management anyway.

channels.name: welcome-aboard
channels.topic: Start here. <Group of workers> - Horde, PvP. Ingen guild, bara en grupp.

channels.name: employee-handbook
channels.topic: The rules. Rule 9 is mandatory.

channels.name: org-chart
channels.topic: Pick your class and your role. React below. Payroll is not affected.

channels.name: new-hires
channels.topic: NEW HIRE!!! say hi in guild chat. Name, class, and one lie about yourself.

channels.name: guild-chat
channels.topic: General. No talking about work in here. This is a WORK FREE ZONE (exception: if u can fix PCs).

channels.name: water-cooler
channels.topic: Off topic. Links, nonsense, things you saw on the way to the office.

channels.name: fika
channels.topic: Memes and gifs only. 15 minutes, twice a day, collectively agreed.

channels.name: hr
channels.topic: Grievances, loot opinions and exit interviews. File it here, not in guild chat.

channels.name: payroll
channels.topic: Gold, trades, auction house, belts for sale. Starting bid 5g.

channels.name: it-support
channels.topic: Addons broken? Account disabled for suspicious inactivity? Open a ticket.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: GM posts. Also where the guild homepage drops its news.

channels.name: gaming-mondays
channels.topic: 19:30. Always has been. React with your role to reserve your place.

channels.name: dungeon-bookings
channels.topic: SFK, BFD, RFC, RoL, DM. Post a time, collect five people, go.

channels.name: looking-for-group
channels.topic: Need one more? Say what, where and when. Do not walk to the other side of the world first.

channels.name: level-checkpoints
channels.topic: Post your ding. Nobody is waiting any more, but we like to know.

channels.name: alt-department
channels.topic: Second characters, third characters. Lowbie runs, RFC and RoL. Where the levelling actually happens now.

channels.name: overtime
channels.topic: The five hours were a guideline. This is where you confess. No consequences, only comments.

channels.name: guild-homepage
channels.topic: Automatic feed from the armory. Roster changes, dings, promotions, leavers.

channels.name: addons-and-macros
channels.topic: Addons, macros, keybinds, and whether an MMO mouse gets through airport security.

channels.name: performance-reviews
channels.topic: Screenshots. Good pulls, bad pulls, scenery.

channels.name: corpse-runs
channels.topic: Obituaries. How you died and whose fault it was.

channels.name: alliance-sightings
channels.topic: Report sightings. Include coordinates and a short emotional statement.

channels.name: Open Office
channels.topic: Default room. Join when you log in, leave it running.

channels.name: The Fireplace
channels.topic: Talking, not levelling. Never counted towards the five hours. Nothing does now.

channels.name: Board Meeting
channels.topic: Where such questions are decided.

channels.name: Quiet Room
channels.topic: Grinding alone together. Mic off.
